caption:
How to order like Large Sahab. Five rules, no exceptions. 🥃

Say your measure. Water on the side. Chakna first. Sip, don’t shoot. Book the cab before the bill.

Which rule do you break? Confess below, and tag your bar buddy.

Never drink and drive.

#BarEtiquette #LargeSahab #EkLarge #WhiskyLovers

scenes.label: RULE 1
scenes.title: Say your measure: “Ek large.”
scenes.body: Not “one strong one”. The bartender isn’t a mind reader.

scenes.label: RULE 3
scenes.title: Order the chakna first.
scenes.body: Before the first peg, not after the third.

scenes.label: RULE 4
scenes.title: Sip. Don’t shoot.
scenes.body: Good whisky is a conversation, not a race.

scenes.label: RULE 5
scenes.title: Book the cab before the bill.
scenes.body: Never drink and drive. Large Sahab insists.
